envelope.description: Fix scripts/daemon-ctl.sh's cmd_update: drop the Darwin+unmanaged re-exec into the signed installer bridge

body.title: Fix scripts/daemon-ctl.sh's cmd_update: drop the Darwin+unmanaged re-exec into the signed installer bridge
body.summary: Remove the Darwin-specific re-exec into insrc-daemon-install.sh in cmd_update's unmanaged (supervised_lifecycle rc=10) branch; let it fall through to the existing plain sync_repo/npm_install_if_needed/npm_build sequence already used on non-Darwin, matching cmd_start/cmd_stop/cmd_restart's existing unmanaged behavior. The managed branch (rc=0) is untouched.
acceptanceChecks: An unmanaged install's `daemon-ctl.sh update` on Darwin completes via git fetch + npm install + npm build with no signing requirement and no call into insrc-daemon-install.sh.
A managed install's `daemon-ctl.sh update` behavior is unchanged.

tests.name: src/daemon/__tests__/macos-upgrade-routing.test.ts: 'Installer and updated CLI, VS Code and JetBrains route matrix' (rewritten)
